types.text/plain: Text with no formatting; the default type for text.
types.text/javascript: JavaScript; application/javascript is its former name (RFC 9239).
types.text/xml: XML readable as it stands; application/xml is preferred.
types.text/event-stream: A stream of events sent by the server (Server-Sent Events).
types.application/ld+json: JSON-LD: linked data, for search engines for instance.
types.application/problem+json: An API error described in JSON (RFC 9457).
types.application/x-ndjson: One JSON document per line; unregistered.
types.application/xhtml+xml: A web page written as XML.
types.application/x-bzip2: A file compressed with bzip2; unregistered.
types.application/x-xz: A file compressed with xz; unregistered.
types.application/vnd.ms-fontobject: An Embedded OpenType font, for the old Internet Explorer.
types.application/octet-stream: Bytes of an unknown type: to download rather than display.
types.application/x-www-form-urlencoded: A form encoded like a query string; what a <form> sends by default.
types.image/gif: A GIF image, animated or not.
types.image/webp: A WebP image, lossy or lossless.
types.image/avif: An AVIF image, more compact than WebP.
types.image/vnd.microsoft.icon: A Windows icon, the historic favicon; often served as image/x-icon.
types.video/mp2t: An MPEG transport stream; .ts is also TypeScript, which has no registered type.
types.font/woff2: A WOFF 2 font, the most compact for the web.
types.multipart/form-data: A form carrying files, each field in its own part.
types.multipart/byteranges: Several ranges of a resource, in a 206 response.
types.multipart/mixed: Parts of different types, in an e-mail for instance.
types.multipart/alternative: The same content in several formats: an e-mail's text and HTML.
